text: Underwater reef. A light blue rectangle as the background, 780 by 480, at 400,250, call it Water.
hmm, more turquoise. change Water to teal
sand along the bottom: light yellow rectangle zone, 780 wide, 90 tall, at 400,445, named Sand
Our fish is called Finn. Medium orange oval at 300,200, name it FinnBody.
tail: small orange triangle at 232,200, Tail
a tiny black circle named Eye at 322,190
group FinnBody, Tail and Eye into Finn
Jellyfish up top: medium purple circle at 620,110, named Jelly.
Under it, 5 px below Jelly, put three tiny purple triangles in a row for the tentacles.
Group Jelly and those three triangles as Jellyfish.
Can you make Finn a friend? Duplicate Finn.
move the copy down 110 pixels
What's in Finn2?
Bubbles! four tiny white circles in a column at 380,110
crab on the sand: small red ellipse at 220,440 named CrabBody
Two claws, tiny red circles: ClawL at 170,430, ClawR, a tiny red circle too, at 270,430
group CrabBody, ClawL and ClawR, call it Crab
Is CrabBody below Jelly?
Treasure chest: brown rectangle 90 by 50 at 640,435, ChestBox
With a tiny gold square on it as the lock, at 640,435, named Lock.
make a group Chest out of ChestBox and Lock
Which group is Lock in?
draw a dashed arrow from FinnBody to ChestBox and write "treasure!" on it
small orange star at 420,450 for a starfish, name it Starfish
medium gray hexagon called Rock at 520,440
Is Rock near Starfish?
seaweed: a thin green rectangle 14 by 110 at 60,370, Weed1
And another green rectangle, a bit shorter, 14 by 80, at 100,385, Weed2.
